context.hint: Review a tool preflight guard that classifies version-control commands before execution.
context.surface: A local command hook receives a shell command and returns a policy decision before any version-control operation is launched.
assumptions: The command guard applies a documented policy to allowed and denied operations.
A fixture can check decisions without executing the underlying commands.

review.invariant: The policy uses the effective operation and parsed arguments. Equivalent representations receive the same decision.
review.verification: Check that equivalent representations of a fixture operation receive the same decision. Use a permitted operation containing a policy keyword as a positive control.

source_observation.summary: The original matcher returned inconsistent decisions for semantically equivalent operations. Evidence came from a compatibility harness running the original patterns because the original shell and JSON dependency were unavailable.
